description: This file contains the implementation of a backend service ('StoreBackendImpl') that handles verification and enrollment of transactions and user public keys in an Android application context. It includes methods to verify cryptographic signatures and manages data structures for transactions and user keys.

classes.name: StoreBackendImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for the StoreBackend interface, managing public keys, transactions, and verification logic.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a transaction against its signature, ensuring it is not a replay and is correctly signed with the user's public key.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Overloaded method that always returns true, simulating password verification.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a new user by associating a user ID with a public key; ignores password in this simulation.
